HOW THE CAPABILITY EVOLVED | G3-G6
Era axis; sequence does not establish causation
|
|-- Expand | 2018 - Q1 2020
|   |-- [R] FY18: analytics/ML inform product development.
|   |-- [S] Q2 2018: Ping launched; includes conversational work with Kit.
|   |-- [S] Q2 2019: fulfillment ML proposed for routing and allocation.
|   `-- [S] Q1 2020: Capital models adapted during geographic expansion.
|-- Surge | Q2 2020 - Q1 2021
|   `-- [I] No distinct initiative is dated to this era in the excerpts.
|-- Build-ahead | Q2 2021 - Q2 2022
|   `-- [I] FY22 Deliverr disclosure mentions ML, but gives no quarter here.
|-- Reckoning | Q3 2022 - Q2 2023
|   |-- [S] Q3 2022: ML already used in fraud and underwriting.
|   |-- [S] Q2 2023 call: Magic unveiled; Sidekick early access still ahead.
|   `-- [S] Logistics sold; lower headcount and logistics costs expected.
|-- Focused compounding | Q3 2023 - Q1 2025
|   |-- [S] Q4 2023: nearly a dozen Magic tools delivered during 2023.
|   `-- [S] Q1 2025: Sidekick engine re-architected; AI-first staffing rule.
`-- Reacceleration | Q2 2025 onward
    |-- [S] Q2 2025: Catalog launched via API or MCP server.
    |-- [S] Early 2026: UCP introduced; distribution broadens.
    `-- [S] Q3 2026: Canvas launched through Sidekick.

[I] Fulfillment ML transfer is not specified by the sale excerpt.
[I] Sidekick's quiet period does not establish a failed initiative.
[I] Catalog: 'two years ago' in Q4 2025 and 'three' in Q3 2026
    are approximate build dates, distinct from the Q2 2025 launch.
